name: Doki Doki Literature Club! Fruits of the Literature Club
source:
Prepare to partake in a thrilling adventure alongside a new main character whose past is shrouded in mystery! You are given the choice of picking one from the four sweet fruits of the Literature Club. Each route has dramatic twists in store and tells a different side of the protagonist’s backstory. This action-packed rollercoaster of a mod is not for the faint of heart. It will keep you on the edge of your seat with it’s immersive narration and dialogue.
But, after all is said and done… The seeds of their future, are sewn in his past.
translation:
准备好与一位过去笼罩在神秘之中的新主角一起参加一场惊心动魄的冒险！你可以从文学俱乐部的四种甜蜜果实中选择一种。每条路线都有戏剧性的曲折，讲述主角背景故事的不同侧面。这个充满动感的过山车模组不适合胆小的人。它的身临其境的旁白和对话会让你坐立不安。
但是，归根结底……他们未来的种子，已经被缝在了他的过去里。
